project_name: Winnie Hou — Business English Mastery LMS

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Editorial Classic Headings + Clean Modern Sans Body
typography.heading_font_family: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif
typography.accent_font_family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug
scale.eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-amber-600 font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous executive spacing, luxury borders with subtle 1px gold/slate strokes, elevated card depth
spacing_and_layout.course_player_layout: Flex/Grid 2-column interface: Left Collapsible Curriculum Rail (w-80), Right Video & Lesson Panel (flex-1). Dark mode viewport for video area with watermark string layer.

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all rounded-xl overflow-hidden p-6 md:p-8
visual_enhancers.featured_card_style: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0A192F] via-[#0F2342] to-[#0A192F] text-white border border-amber-500/30 rounded-xl shadow-xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden
visual_enhancers.gold_badge: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200
visual_enhancers.watermark_overlay: absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-15 select-none flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono text-white/40 tracking-widest uppercase transform -rotate-12 z-20

component_guidelines.header_nav: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A192F]/95 text-white border-b border-amber-500/20 z-50 px-6 py-4. Contains logo ('WINNIE HOU'), Course Catalog, Shop, Blog, My Courses, Cart, Auth CTA.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A192F] hover:bg-[#0F2342] text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 shadow-md hover:border-amber-500/60 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.gold_cta: bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-[#0A192F] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg hover:shadow-amber-500/20 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-slate-800 font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 transition-all cursor-pointer

component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox heavily customized with rounded-lg border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500/50 focus:border-amber-500 p-3

winnie_instructor.usage: Hero section, About instructor section, Course detail author box

winnie_holding_book.usage: Shop workbook cards, digital product details

executive_meeting.usage: Course detail hero banner, corporate training section

presentation_collaboration.usage: Blog post headers, course module card background

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the navy (#0A192F), gold (#D4AF37), and ivory/white visual identity strictly.
Implement editorial typography: Playfair Display for main titles and section headings, Inter for body and dashboard text.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Build full functionality for Student LMS flow, Shop, Checkout, Course Player with watermark overlay, and Admin CMS at /admin.
Ensure Bunny Stream video player simulation includes watermark overlay showing the active student email.
Provide filtering, search, coupon application, progress tracking, and full admin management.
